We dedicate CJSF's 2026 Fundrive to the late Robin Eriksson, our Programming Coordinator from 2016 to 2025, who passed away in early Sept. following a battle with cancer.

🌐 Read our in memoriam post for Robin here: https://cjsf.ca/news/memoriam-robin-eriksson-1964-2026
